headline: Meetings get their own pages on the Hub. Open an upcoming meeting for a live prep page: what to cover, what is owed both ways and what was left open last time, saved with one Undo; attach a link or a file, which shows in the next brief. Past meetings lists the last seven days with what each still needs, and one press opens its wrap-up to place your promises and close it out. Refresh builds in about a quarter of the time, a move never hides work out of sight, and every scheduled task records how long each step took. After updating, say "update my hub".
